en.text: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

footnotes.text: 105:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名， 在万民中传扬他的作为！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要稱謝耶和華， 求告他的名， 在萬民中傳揚他的作為！

en.text: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

zhSimplified.text: 要向他唱诗歌颂， 谈论他一切奇妙的作为！

zhTraditional.text: 要向他唱詩歌頌， 談論他一切奇妙的作為！

en.text: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

zhSimplified.text: 要以他的圣名夸耀！ 寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜！

zhTraditional.text: 要以他的聖名誇耀！ 尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜！

en.text: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

zhSimplified.text: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。

zhTraditional.text: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力， 時常尋求他的面。

en.text: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

zhSimplified.text: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔， 他所拣选雅各的子孙哪， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事， 并他口中的判语。

zhTraditional.text: 他僕人亞伯拉罕的後裔， 他所揀選雅各的子孫哪， 你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事， 並他口中的判語。

en.text: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他是耶和华—我们的 神； 全地都有他的判断。

zhTraditional.text: 他是耶和華－我們的上帝； 全地都有他的判斷。

en.text: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

zhSimplified.text: 他记念他的约，直到永远； 他所吩咐的话，直到千代—

zhTraditional.text: 他記念他的約，直到永遠； 他所吩咐的話，直到千代－

en.text: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

zhSimplified.text: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 向以撒所起的誓。

zhTraditional.text: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的約， 向以撒所起的誓。

en.text: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

zhSimplified.text: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永远的约，

zhTraditional.text: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例， 向以色列定為永遠的約，

en.text: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

zhSimplified.text: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你， 作你产业的分。

zhTraditional.text: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你， 作你產業的分。

en.text: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少， 并且在那地为寄居的。

zhTraditional.text: 當時，他們人丁有限，數目稀少， 並且在那地為寄居的。

en.text: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

zhSimplified.text: 他们从这邦游到那邦， 从这国行到那国。

zhTraditional.text: 他們從這邦遊到那邦， 從這國行到那國。

en.text: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

zhSimplified.text: 他不容什么人欺负他们， 为他们的缘故责备君王，

zhTraditional.text: 他不容甚麼人欺負他們， 為他們的緣故責備君王，

en.text: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

zhSimplified.text: 说：不可难为我受膏的人， 也不可恶待我的先知。

zhTraditional.text: 說：不可難為我受膏的人， 也不可惡待我的先知。

en.text: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

zhSimplified.text: 他命饥荒降在那地上， 将所倚靠的粮食全行断绝，

zhTraditional.text: 他命饑荒降在那地上， 將所倚靠的糧食全行斷絕，

en.text: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

zhSimplified.text: 在他们以先打发一个人去 —约瑟被卖为奴仆。

zhTraditional.text: 在他們以先打發一個人去 －約瑟被賣為奴僕。

en.text: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

zhSimplified.text: 人用脚镣伤他的脚； 他被铁链捆拘。

zhTraditional.text: 人用腳鐐傷他的腳； 他被鐵鍊捆拘。

en.text: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的话试炼他， 直等到他所说的应验了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的話試煉他， 直等到他所說的應驗了。

en.text: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

zhSimplified.text: 王打发人把他解开， 就是治理众民的，把他释放，

zhTraditional.text: 王打發人把他解開， 就是治理眾民的，把他釋放，

en.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

zhSimplified.text: 立他作王家之主， 掌管他一切所有的，

zhTraditional.text: 立他作王家之主， 掌管他一切所有的，

en.text: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

zhSimplified.text: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰， 将智慧教导他的长老。

zhTraditional.text: 使他隨意捆綁他的臣宰， 將智慧教導他的長老。

en.text: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列也到了埃及； 雅各在含地寄居。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列也到了埃及； 雅各在含地寄居。

en.text: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多， 使他们比敌人强盛，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使他的百姓生養眾多， 使他們比敵人強盛，

en.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓， 并用诡计待他的仆人。

zhTraditional.text: 使敵人的心轉去恨他的百姓， 並用詭計待他的僕人。

en.text: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

zhSimplified.text: 他打发他的仆人摩西 和他所拣选的亚伦，

zhTraditional.text: 他打發他的僕人摩西 和他所揀選的亞倫，

en.text: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

zhSimplified.text: 在敌人中间显他的神迹， 在含地显他的奇事。

zhTraditional.text: 在敵人中間顯他的神蹟， 在含地顯他的奇事。

en.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

zhSimplified.text: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗； 没有违背他话的。

zhTraditional.text: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗； 沒有違背他話的。

en.text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

zhSimplified.text: 他叫埃及的水变为血， 叫他们的鱼死了。

zhTraditional.text: 他叫埃及的水變為血， 叫他們的魚死了。

en.text: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

zhSimplified.text: 在他们的地上以及王宫的内室， 青蛙多多滋生。

zhTraditional.text: 在他們的地上以及王宮的內室， 青蛙多多滋生。

en.text: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

zhSimplified.text: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来， 并有虱子进入他们四境。

zhTraditional.text: 他說一聲，蒼蠅就成群而來， 並有虱子進入他們四境。

en.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

zhSimplified.text: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨， 在他们的地上降下火焰。

zhTraditional.text: 他給他們降下冰雹為雨， 在他們的地上降下火焰。

en.text: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

zhSimplified.text: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树， 毁坏他们境内的树木。

zhTraditional.text: 他也擊打他們的葡萄樹和無花果樹， 毀壞他們境內的樹木。

en.text: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

zhSimplified.text: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来， 不计其数，

zhTraditional.text: 他說一聲，就有蝗蟲螞蚱上來， 不計其數，

en.text: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

zhSimplified.text: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬 和田地的出产。

zhTraditional.text: 吃盡了他們地上各樣的菜蔬 和田地的出產。

en.text: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

zhSimplified.text: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子， 就是他们强壮时头生的。

zhTraditional.text: 他又擊殺他們國內一切的長子， 就是他們強壯時頭生的。

en.text: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

zhSimplified.text: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来； 他支派中没有一个软弱的。

zhTraditional.text: 他領自己的百姓帶銀子金子出來； 他支派中沒有一個軟弱的。

en.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜； 原来埃及人惧怕他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他們出來的時候，埃及人便歡喜； 原來埃及人懼怕他們。

en.text: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

zhSimplified.text: 他铺张云彩当遮盖， 夜间使火光照。

zhTraditional.text: 他鋪張雲彩當遮蓋， 夜間使火光照。

en.text: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

zhSimplified.text: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来， 并用天上的粮食叫他们饱足。

zhTraditional.text: 他們一求，他就使鵪鶉飛來， 並用天上的糧食叫他們飽足。

en.text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

zhSimplified.text: 他打开磐石，水就涌出； 在干旱之处，水流成河。

zhTraditional.text: 他打開磐石，水就湧出； 在乾旱之處，水流成河。

en.text: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

zhSimplified.text: 这都因他记念他的圣言 和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。

zhTraditional.text: 這都因他記念他的聖言 和他的僕人亞伯拉罕。

en.text: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

zhSimplified.text: 他带领百姓欢乐而出， 带领选民欢呼前往。

zhTraditional.text: 他帶領百姓歡樂而出， 帶領選民歡呼前往。

en.text: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

zhSimplified.text: 他将列国的地赐给他们， 他们便承受众民劳碌得来的，

zhTraditional.text: 他將列國的地賜給他們， 他們便承受眾民勞碌得來的，

en.text: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 好使他们遵他的律例， 守他的律法。 你们要赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 好使他們遵他的律例， 守他的律法。 你們要讚美耶和華！
